source.what: Validation of the whole chain on real Perseverance Navcam photos with known positions.
source.note: No prior and no truth were given to the engine; the truth is used only for scoring. The matcher is not yet validated (known to be uncalibrated): read these errors as a baseline to rerun after the engine fixes. Samples and residuals left out of this copy (see the full file).
